# Accepted differences between pail and the recorded AWS S3 behavior.
#
# One per line: <scenario>/<step> <field> <reason, with an issue link>
# <field> is status, body, or header:<Name>, as the failure message prints it.
# An unlisted difference fails the test. A listed one that no longer occurs
# also fails, so remove the line when the difference is fixed.
sns-auth-errors/no-credentials body pail routes requests by SigV4 scope and never reads bodies, so an unsigned SNS form POST reaches S3; real clients always sign https://github.com/yavosh/pail/pull/55

sns-auth-errors/no-credentials header:X-Amz-Request-Id pail routes requests by SigV4 scope and never reads bodies, so an unsigned SNS form POST reaches S3; real clients always sign https://github.com/yavosh/pail/pull/55
sns-auth-errors/no-credentials header:X-Amzn-Requestid pail routes requests by SigV4 scope and never reads bodies, so an unsigned SNS form POST reaches S3; real clients always sign https://github.com/yavosh/pail/pull/55
sqs-dead-letter/list-dlq-sources body AWS lists dead-letter source queues with eventual consistency, and the recording ran seconds after create-source; pail lists the source at once https://github.com/yavosh/pail/pull/59
